page.layout: One printed page. One column of running text, with two notes in the left margin: "Fivel-gonij." beside the line "Fivel-", and "Die Dmb-landen." beside "Atque hi". The catchword "regioni" stands at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: nis, in fluminis ripâ, quâ in occasum se vertere incipit, ad litus boreum pertinens; quarta ab aggere interiore cognominata, in aquilonem ab urbe vergens, rivoque Dammonensi in cæciam ventum ab urbe defluenti contigua; postrema cunctis prioribus major per quina passuum millia juxta litus idem exterius porrecta, pariqué fere spatio intus patescens: Fivel-Fivel-gonij.gonij Hunesgonios ad ortum sequentes in Amasi orâ, similiter in duas divisi partes, quarum prior xxxi vicos complexa insignes, nulli superiorum felicitate cedit, tum ob terræ bonitatem, tum ob commoda fluminis vicini: altera vicis rarior, quos ix tantum habet, palustri fere, & passim humili ac uliginoso solo, in austrum priorem sequens, ad interiora vergens, per quam ab ortu venientibus iter Groningam est: eam Duerswoldiam proprio nomine appellitant. Atque hiDie Dmb-landen. sunt populi, quos nunc Vmlandes nuncupamus. Cujus quidem vocabuli ἔτυμον[?] si spectas, & si exempla intueharis in literarum nostratium monumentis, non verè proprium id nomen esse, huic tantum regioni
main_text.notes: Catchword "regioni" lies at the lower right, below the last line. The Greek word "ἔτυμον" is uncertain in its accents and letters. The Greek mark is printed in italic. The note "Die Dmb-landen" is in black letter. The first word "nis," is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The note "Fivel-gonij" sits beside the hyphenated line "Fivel-" with the word continued in the next line.
